text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Turbo's goal is to win lots and lots! 'Cause I wanna win!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All right!! I'm throwing down the gauntlet
to every single one of them~!!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
